en.title: Words that left the commit log and words that arrived (git history to October 19, 2026)
items: Aug-Dec 2025: fixes clearly stating a cause (of 29)
Sep-Oct 2026: fixes clearly stating a cause (of 73)
en.note: Merge commits excluded. Causes were judged by reading every fix commit; the keyword rule gives 0 and 33.
en.alt: Bar chart: subjects claiming completion fell from 21 commits in August to December 2025 to 0 in September and October 2026, while fix commits clearly stating a cause rose from 1 of 29 to 56 of 73.
